notes.title: Barbearian update 1.0.12
notes.notes:
What's New in version 1.0.12?

- Russian localization (Полностью на русском языке)
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Barbearian update 1.0.9
notes.notes:
What's New?

- New languages added:
+ Spanish (Completamente en español)
+ Italian (Completamente in italiano)

- Frame pacing code changed to better support low framerates on low power devices when using high detail mode
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Barbearian update 1.0.7
notes.notes:
What's New?

- New languages added:
  + German (Komplett in Deutsch)
  + French (Entièrement traduit en Français)
  + Japan (日本語に完全対応)
  + Chinese Simplified (全中文支持)

- Support for new gamepad types

notes.title: Barbearian update 1.0.6 is out!
notes.notes:
What's New?

- Finnish translation (more languages coming later)
- Fixed health fountain sometimes getting destroyed by asteroids
- Balancing and minor fixes
